warnings: Footing marks on this sheet are printed as 'F<n>,C1' — the pile count is encoded in the mark (F2=2, F3=3, F4=4, F7=7, F8=8, F10=10 เสาเข็มต่อฐาน, confirmed against the S-05..S-07 details), and ',C1' names the column each footing carries. Columns are recorded here as their own C1 entry because this is the only plan sheet that prints the column mark; the beam plan S-03 draws the same columns unlabeled.

F2 (stair-landing footing) sits off-grid: its cap is the 1.30×1.00 landing between dummy lines 2''-2''' (x) centred on C'' (y). Recorded with an area grid_ref rather than a point per §0.8; its two piles sit on the C'' line at 0.30 from each cap end (S-05 detail).
